subject: Novum Clinic field week — plan for coverage + async follow-ups
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@novumclinic.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: kendall.price@novumclinic.com
Date: 2026-09-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Field week in Portland — confirm on-site schedule?

Hi Ben,

Thanks again — our team is finalizing the itinerary for the Portland field week (Oct 5–9). We'd love to keep the vendor deep-dive on Oct 7, but there are two competing travel commitments that just popped up for our ops and site leads (they're now traveling between Oct 6–8 for a regional conference).

Options on our side: compress the deep-dive into a 90-minute session on Oct 6 afternoon, split it into a recorded walkthrough + live office hours, or move it to Oct 9 when most stakeholders return. We also need to get a signed SOW in place before any onsite work.

I've attached an initial agenda and the internal site-visit checklist. Can Redwood do a shorter live session + recording, or should we look to move to Oct 9?

Best,
Alicia Moreno
Clinical Ops Program Manager
Novum Clinic

Attachments: Novum_Agenda_v1.pdf (PDF), site-visit-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@novumclinic.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Field week in Portland — confirm on-site schedule?

Hi Alicia — appreciate the heads up.

We can absolutely adapt. Quick suggestions: 
- Option A (preferred for onboarding quality): Move the live deep-dive to Oct 9, keep Oct 6/7 for short touchpoints and the site tour. That preserves a full, uninterrupted demo for decision-makers.
- Option B (compact): Run a 75–90 minute focused demo on Oct 6 afternoon + produce a polished recording of the full walkthrough; follow up with a 30-minute live Q&A on Oct 9.
- Option C (all async): Provide a recorded walkthrough and host two 25-minute office-hour slots on Oct 6 and Oct 9 for stakeholders in different timezones.

We can also fast-track the SOW — I attached our draft for your legal team to review (Redwood_SOW_Draft.docx). Marissa, can you confirm SLA language and the expedited signature path? Sean, would you be available to run the shorter live format on Oct 6 if we go compact?

Alicia — which option best matches Novum's priorities? If you want Oct 9, we can tentatively pencil the 9:00–11:00 PT block and capture the demo to share with the traveling group.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@novumclinic.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-22T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Field week in Portland — confirm on-site schedule?

Looping in operations notes — we can support Option B (compact live + recording) and expedite the SOW routing. A couple of practicals: 
- SLA addendum: we can offer a 30-day trial-like credit and 72-hour rollback window for the first rollout on your dev environment (we'll put specifics in the SOW).
- Recording & deliverables: Sean, please plan to capture the full 60–75 minute production walkthrough and produce a 20–25 minute executive summary clip.
- Onsite logistics: we will bring an HDMI kit and a backup laptop; please confirm AV access on-site.

Alicia — if you can confirm approval for the compressed live session on Oct 6 at 2:30–4:00 PM PT, we'll lock Sean and record. If not, we'll move the full session to Oct 9 9:00–11:00 AM PT.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_Draft.docx

From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@novumclinic.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: kendall.price@novumclinic.com
Date: 2026-09-23T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Field week in Portland — plan for coverage + async follow-ups

Thanks everyone — short answer: Option B works best. Kendall and I confirmed offline — their travel window is fixed (regional conference), and they prefer a compact live session that they can join briefly plus the recording to share with the rest of leadership.

Please proceed with Oct 6, 2:30–4:00 PM PT for the live compressed demo (we'll have a small in-person audience + remote participants). Confirm AV needs and whether you need a visiting network access form. We'll sign the SOW this week.

Alicia
